Market today: The mood is mixed. While CoreWeave's strong report and CEO's comments reaffirm robust AI compute demand, the broader "AI trade" is stumbling, driving market angst and a shift to low-volatility stocks. This creates conflicting signals for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-70.03%) and MUU (-48.63%) are deeply underwater leveraged ETFs with "SELL" statuses; their default stops offer no real protection. QQQI (-7.48%) is also a "SELL" and just below its stop. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on whether the "AI trade" continues to stumble, and how that impacts your high-beta, leveraged positions. Monitor for any further rotation out of tech.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your deeply losing leveraged positions.
plays: Consider exiting QQQI if it fails to reclaim 52; it's a "SELL" and below its stop.
Re-evaluate the deep losses in SOXL (-70.03%) and MUU (-48.63%). Their default stops are not protecting capital on these leveraged positions.
Trim CRWD (+34.81%) to reduce tech concentration and free up margin, especially with the "AI trade stumbles" signal.
